program.intent: Reversible timestamp transformation to epoch microseconds including timezone offset
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    day, month, year, hour, minute, second, sp1, tz_offset = groups
    text = f'{day}/{month}/{year} {hour}:{minute}:{second} {tz_offset}'
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%d/%b/%Y %H:%M:%S %z')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = int(layout[0])
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    day = dt.strftime('%d')
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    hour = dt.strftime('%H')
    minute = dt.strftime('%M')
    second = dt.strftime('%S')
    tz_offset = dt.strftime('%z')
    return f'[{day}/{month}/{year}:{hour}:{minute}:{second}' + (' ' * sp1_len) + tz_offset + ']'
